declaration_source: Direct instructions from the project owner in the Synesis working conversation, following the earlier statement that research and eventual training are permitted
declaration: Completar Synesis con los PDFs disponibles y datasets reutilizables para otros proyectos, en el repositorio público ya autorizado.

scope.materials: Publicly accessible original PDFs and PDF annexes from institutional sources, plus page/chunk extraction and retrieval derivatives
scope.excluded: Restricted copies, request-a-copy workflows, login-only resources and URLs explicitly disallowed by robots.txt

licensing: Preserve source_license and evidence per file. This owner request creates no new blanket CC0, MIT, commercial-use or training license for third parties. Original PDFs may identify authors and contain other personal information.
